## List Tree Indentation Guides 2.0.0

- Adds **List Hover Breadcrumb** in Live Preview, Source, Reading mode, and internal embeds. It displays a scrollable ancestor hierarchy with source-aware navigation, current-item highlighting, hover previews, keyboard controls, wrapping, and global/per-mode dismissal timers.
- Adds the requested activation-scope hierarchy, enabled-by-default breadcrumb markers and static guides, and disabled-by-default breadcrumb threading. Popup guide/thread controls and styling are independent of main-view settings. Subordinate settings become inaccessible when their parent feature is disabled.
- Replaces fixed Reading-mode connector offsets with measured per-surface SVG geometry. Internal heading/block embeds have isolated overlays and source-position mapping, including ancestors outside a partial embed.
- Adds **Thread connector height** in both main and breadcrumb **List thread geometry**. The default is 100% of the available vertical gap, starting below the parent marker with stroke-cap clearance. Lower percentages shorten the elbow independently of its horizontal length and vertical offset.
- Renames the three main controls to **List Static Tree Indentation Guides**, **List Threading**, and **Unmarked List Head List Threading**. Saved preference keys remain compatible.
- Retires the old fixed Reading-mode row-height and overlap compensation controls, which are replaced by measured geometry.
- Carries the Community review cleanups forward and adds Chromium regression tests to validation and release workflows. Release assets retain GitHub attestations.

Validation: automated source/geometry/settings tests and Chromium layout/interaction fixtures cover embeds, hover scopes, navigation, marker clearance, and independent styles. **Obsidian desktop behavior has not been verified in this environment.** See the repository's `docs/validation-2.0.0.md` for scope and the desktop acceptance checklist.
